prompt:
Fix the snippet snippets/product-tags-list.liquid so that it renders a clean list of product tags. Input (a top-level variable, not under section.settings): - tags: an array of strings, or null. Entries may have leading or trailing whitespace, such as spaces, tabs or newlines. Some entries may be empty or contain only whitespace. Rules: 1. Remove leading and trailing whitespace from each tag, as the core strip filter does. Keep whitespace inside a tag exactly as it is. For example, " gift idea " becomes "gift idea". 2. Skip a tag if it is empty after trimming. 3. Keep every remaining tag in its original order, including duplicates. 4. If at least one tag remains, output exactly:
    followed by one
  • TAG
    • per remaining tag, then
. Do not put any whitespace or newlines between or around the elements. 5. HTML-escape each trimmed tag. For example, < becomes <, > becomes >, & becomes & and " becomes ". 6. If tags is null, is an empty array, or contains only empty or whitespace-only entries, output nothing (empty string). Never output an empty
    . Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/product-tags-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
